The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
Unspecified cardiac arrhythmia is coded I49.9
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying rhythm disturbances and to guide further management
The service is consistent with the clinical indication note
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded CPT 93229
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the recurrent syncope and presyncope described in the indication note
The service is not merely for another payer to cover
